environment.description: Lambda function URL configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The function's resource-based policy grants lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl only to principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/internal-service-role with condition StringEquals aws:PrincipalOrgID=o-abc123def4. No additional IAM users or roles have been granted invoke permissions. The function URL endpoint responds with HTTP 403 {"Message":"Forbidden"} to any request that does not carry a valid SigV4 signature from the authorized principal. Note: the binary itself still contains the double-free vulnerability and the Lambda execution role has standard CloudWatch permissions.
